description: Establish a green baseline and audit the K2 evaluation machinery. Create the Python 3.11 venv, install deps, install pnpm deps, run the three K2-targeted pytest suites plus the full offline suite and pnpm test:js, and audit (read-only, no source-eligibility or fertilizer changes) the development/held-out split, claim ledger, participant-task ledger, and the (currently missing) release-decision generator so later features are grounded in exact current behavior.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/dakikobo-k2, create the venv with the 3.11 interpreter: `python3.11 -m venv .venv` (python3.11 is at /root/.pyenv/shims/python3.11; system python3 is 3.9 and too old for the repo's `str | None` unions). Then `.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`.
Install JS deps: `pnpm install` (devDependency jsdom; package.json defines test:js => `node --test tests/js/*.test.js`).

Run baseline: `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py tests/test_evidence_ledger.py tests/test_evaluate_rag.py`, then `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests --ignore=tests/test_rag.py`, then `pnpm test:js`, then `git diff --check`. Record exact passed/failed/skipped/warning counts for each. Do NOT run tests/test_rag.py (needs live Groq/HF).

Audit and record findings (in the feature's findings field) for: (a) scripts/farmer_evaluation.py assess()/assess_claims()/assess_tasks() and the prepare_* generators — confirm split separation logic, that claim grounding uses claims as denominator with >=90%, and that pilot success + comprehension use participant x task observations each requiring >=80%; (b) that there is currently NO release-decision scaffold generator (only the static evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md); (c) reusable identity helpers: core.rag_pipeline.build_source_manifest (corpus identity), core.answer_safety.safety_policy_revision (policy revision), config.LLM_MODEL/GEMINI_MODEL/EMBEDDING_MODEL (model config), git commit SHA.

Append a short dated entry to SESSION.md (append only; the file is large ~106KB) noting: branch k2-release-evaluation, baseline test results, and the audit conclusions. Do not rewrite existing SESSION.md content.
acceptance_criteria: .venv exists and was built with Python 3.11; `.venv/bin/python --version` reports 3.11.x
All three verification pytest commands and pnpm test:js run to completion with their exact totals captured
findings field records current split/claim/task behavior and confirms no scaffold generator exists yet
No changes to core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, or Data/reviews/* eligibility verdicts
findings: ENV: venv built with /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python3.11 (the pyenv shim `python3.11` was not on PATH; use the versioned path). `.venv/bin/python --version` = Python 3.11.15. Node 22 + pnpm 10. Network OPEN_INTERNET; pip and pnpm installs succeeded. BASELINE TEST TOTALS (no code changes, exact): (1) `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_farmer_evaluation.py tests/test_evidence_ledger.py tests/test_evaluate_rag.py` => 25 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 warnings. (2) `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests --ignore=tests/test_rag.py` => 679 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 1 warning (PyPDF2 DeprecationWarning). (3) `pnpm test:js` => 33 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped (tests 33). (4) `git diff --check` => clean, no whitespace errors. tests/test_rag.py deliberately NOT run (needs live Groq/HF). AUDIT scripts/farmer_evaluation.py: assess() screens a scorecard and enforces split separation — row_splits must be exactly {development}, exactly {held_out}, or exactly {development, held_out}; any other mix returns False ('Scorecard must contain one complete split or the complete benchmark.'). It also checks completeness (len==expected and id set match, else 'Incomplete or duplicate case identifiers.'), reviewer present + safety_pass/grounding_pass/task_success/understood_next_action all in {yes,no}, fails closed if any critical case safety_pass!=yes, then grounding>=.9 AND success>=.8 AND understood>=.8 (screening only; message notes claim-level evidence and participant results kept separately). assess_claims(): denominator = substantive claims reviewed; rejects empty/invalid header, duplicate (case_id,claim_id), unknown case or split mismatch, incomplete required fields (case_id,split,claim_id,claim_text,source,page,excerpt,supported,reviewer), supported not in {yes,no}; PASS iff supported/total >= .9. assess_tasks(): requires >=8 participant codes and exactly the 5 PILOT_TASKS (sowing, crop_problem, fertilizer, offline, saved_case) per participant (set(identities)==expected), rejects duplicate (participant_code,task_id), unknown task, incomplete fields, non-yes/no outcomes; applies TWO SEPARATE >=80% gates on participant x task observations: completed_independently/total>=.8 AND understood_next_action/total>=.8. prepare()/prepare_claims()/prepare_tasks() only emit blank templates/headers (no invented evidence). NO RELEASE-DECISION SCAFFOLD GENERATOR EXISTS: scripts/ has audit_source_eligibility.py, check_groq_models.py, check_trusted_sources.py, evaluate_rag.py, export_feedback_eval.py, export_offline_fertilizer.py, farmer_evaluation.py, firecrawl_ingest.py, pdf_to_md.py, refresh_trusted_sources.py, test_gemini.py, vision_eval_helpers.py — none generate a release decision. Only the static evaluation/RELEASE_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md exists (French, defaults to REPORTÉ, gates table with denominators + thresholds 0-fail/>=90%/>=80%/>=80%). FEAT-003 must add the generator. REUSABLE IDENTITY HELPERS (verified): core.rag_pipeline.build_source_manifest(file_paths, *, source_type, external_sources=None) -> dict with version=1, source_type, embedding_model, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, external_sources (sorted), files=[{path, bytes, sha256}] sorted by path — corpus identity. core.answer_safety.safety_policy_revision() -> '<version>.<digest12>'; runtime value verified = 'safety-2026-09-09.1f0345c393fd' (SAFETY_POLICY_VERSION='safety-2026-09-09'). config.LLM_MODEL='openai/gpt-oss-120b', config.GEMINI_MODEL='gemini-2.5-flash', config.EMBEDDING_MODEL='paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2'. Commit SHA via `git rev-parse HEAD` (currently e2fc384bcc7da2e3bfa6bf9f5bfa625f2c113741). CONSTRAINTS: no changes to core/fertilizer.py, core/source_policy.py, static/data/fertilizer.json, Data/reviews/* eligibility verdicts; NUMERIC_GUIDANCE_VERIFIED left False; no live evaluation run. Only SESSION.md was modified (dated K2 FEAT-001 entry appended).
